content: Refunds are allowed only within 30 days of purchase; after that, offer account credit instead.
Enterprise customers get a dedicated support engineer and a four-hour first-response SLA.
Never share a customer's billing address over chat; direct them to the account portal.
Weekend escalations page the on-call engineer only for severity-1 outages.
To reset a locked account: verify the last four digits of the payment card, clear the lockout flag, then send a password-reset link.
Acme Freight's billing account number is BR-88214.
Acme Freight runs on the Enterprise plan with 240 seats.
Dana at Acme Freight wants to be contacted by email only, never by phone.
Acme Freight authenticates its users through Okta single sign-on.
We promised Acme Freight a written incident report by the 14th.
Acme Freight's head office is in Rotterdam and their team works Central European hours.
Acme Freight opened fourteen tickets last quarter, mostly about label printing.
Nimbus Retail's billing account number is BR-40977.
Nimbus Retail is on the Growth plan and has asked about upgrading twice.
Do not offer Nimbus Retail a refund — their contract settles disputes as account credit only.
Nimbus Retail can only deploy changes during their Tuesday 02:00 UTC maintenance window.
Priya at Nimbus Retail prefers a short summary first and the detail underneath.
Nimbus Retail's warehouse scanners run an old Android build that cannot be updated remotely.
FieldWorks Ltd's billing account number is BR-51330.
Stop suggesting the CSV importer to FieldWorks Ltd; it corrupts their multi-line address fields. Use the API import instead.
FieldWorks Ltd imports customer records from a legacy Access database every Monday.
Tom at FieldWorks Ltd asks for screenshots rather than written steps.
We owe FieldWorks Ltd a decision on their custom-field request by end of month.
FieldWorks Ltd has three admins, all in the Manchester office.
Kestrel Labs' billing account number is BR-27604.
Kestrel Labs is not eligible for the startup discount any more — they raised a Series B in March.
Kestrel Labs restricts data processing to the EU region for compliance reasons.
Sam at Kestrel Labs would rather have a call than a long email thread.
Kestrel Labs evaluates every vendor with a two-week security review before signing.
Kestrel Labs asked for a longer trial in February and we extended it by ten days.
Harbor Foods' billing account number is BR-93518.
Harbor Foods pays annually by bank transfer, not by card.
Nia at Harbor Foods asked us to copy her operations lead on anything about deliveries.
Harbor Foods has depots in Lisbon, Porto and Braga that each report stock separately.
We agreed to review Harbor Foods' invoice discrepancy before their next billing run.
Harbor Foods' contact hours are 07:00 to 15:00 because their drivers start early.
Orchid Health's billing account number is BR-66042.
Orchid Health signed a data-processing agreement covering patient records.
Ravi at Orchid Health wants tickets closed only after he confirms, not automatically.
Orchid Health's staff share a small number of kiosk logins across each clinic.
Orchid Health asked twice about exporting an audit trail for their regulator.
